# `storage/LegacyStorageReadback.js`

> **Source:** `webgpu-os/storage/LegacyStorageReadback.js`

LegacyStorageReadback.js — encrypted VFS readback for durable localStorage. Older OS modules still use localStorage directly. Rewriting every caller at once would create migration risk, so this service captures writes made while one OperatorContext is active into that operator's AppSandbox. This service never restores origin-global localStorage. LegacyOperatorMigration may seed only strictly validated window geometry for one unambiguous Passport; every other historical localStorage record remains quarantined. AppSandbox publishes only newly attributable writes as authenticated account-and-device-bound ciphertext. OPFS fallback records and rebuildable caches are deliberately excluded because their authoritative data already lives elsewhere.
